name: Decyl D-glucopyranoside
description: Decyl D-glucopyranoside (CAS 54549-25-6 ), also known as Decyl D-glucoside, is a mild, plant-derived nonionic surfactant used across personal care and food-contact applications. It delivers effective foaming, emulsification, and cleansing performance. This surfactant remains highly compatible with sensitive formulation environments. In personal care, it functions as a primary or co-surfactant in facial cleansers, shampoos, and body washes where low irritation potential is a priority. It supports stable foam generation and soil removal in rinse-off products targeting sensitive skin or baby care lines. In food-contact and food processing contexts, it is evaluated as a cleaning and degreasing agent. Residue profile and regulatory acceptance are key sourcing considerations for industrial applications. Formulators also incorporate it into emulsified systems where a mild, biodegradable surfactant is required for green chemistry. Decyl D-glucopyranoside is typically supplied as an aqueous solution, with active content concentration being a key specification to confirm with suppliers. Technical and cosmetic-grade material are the most common forms. Buyers should verify purity, active matter content, and compliance documentation relevant to their target market before finalizing sourcing.
